messages:
Alex: heads up — customer ABC reported a large p95/p99 latency spike after last night's billing/auth change. they reported 500s and long tails for text-gen. anyone seeing infra signals?
Maria: filing INC-4021 and looping in support. customer trace attached to ticket. they started seeing issues ~02:10 UTC.
OpsBot: deploy event: release/quant-profiles/2026-03-17 by ci-user — enabled profile: redwood-open-13b-int8-calib on pool 'shared-gpu-1' (02:05 UTC)
Ryan: looking at runtime metrics: redwood-open-13b-instruct-int8 p95 went from ~320ms -> ~980ms, p99 to ~1.6s on that pool. token throughput dropped ~40%.
Priya: runtime KV cache miss rate jumped at same time. also batch sizes collapsed to tiny micro-batches (1-2 requests) — likely higher RT due to overhead per-request with int8 path.
Jane: customer logs show bursts of 401/429 from auth gateway, client retries immediately (no jitter) — lots of small retries hitting model endpoint.
Alex: OK — hypothesis: auth/billing change caused extra retries -> smaller batches -> int8 calibration path has higher fixed overhead -> p95/p99 blow up.
Ryan: repro steps local:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.infer/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"redwood-open-13b-instruct-int8","input":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":256}'
```
When I hammer with many short concurrent requests I see per-request syscall overhead and quant pre/post processing taking ~200-350ms extra per call on int8 variant.
Priya: quick mitigation options: 1) route org=ABC to fp16 variant for now; 2) temporarily disable int8 profile on that GPU pool; 3) increase KV cache TTL and enable prefix caching; 4) add retry-backoff guideline in gateway to avoid tight loops.
Maria: customer wants fast fix. they accept temporary perf rollback as workaround.
Alex: do 1) canary route + 2) disable int8 on shared-gpu-1. Notify customers. Also add a fail-open fallback: if int8 path latency > 700ms for 5m, auto-fallback to fp16 for that org.
Priya: I'm patching routing rule now:
```
PATCH /routing/policies/abc
{ "match": {"org_id":"abc"}, "action": {"model_variant":"redwood-open-13b-instruct-fp16","ttl": 3600}}
```
Applying change to canary nodes first.
OpsBot: deploy event: routing-change/3345621500 by priya — policy applied to canary (02:28 UTC)
Ryan: triggered fp16 canary for org=ABC — initial p95 looks much better, down to ~340ms. Monitoring p99.
Maria: customer on call confirmed improved responsiveness in their staging a few minutes after patch. they will validate production traffic.
Priya: also disabled int8-calib on shared-gpu-1 pool and bumped kv-cache TTL from 5s -> 30s. pushing metric alerts to watch for reversion.
Alex: good. next actions: 1) write short runbook for quant-profile rollouts (include quick rollback cmd and fallbacks), 2) add gating to deploy pipeline to check auth/gateway health and retry behavior before profile swaps, 3) follow-up root cause with infra/auth team about why auth change caused immediate retries (client or gateway).
Jane: adding customer note to INC-4021 and closing customer-facing loop.
Ryan: long term: need perf budget test for int8 path under high small-request churn and update calibration to reduce per-request overhead if possible.
Maria: thanks all — will update ticket and monitor. :thumbsup:
